name: Sakina Salah
summary: Sakina's dove carries prayer in its wing: a folded prayer rug becomes part of the bird itself.
why: The original dove keeps its gentle head and rounded body. Its raised wing becomes a folded prayer rug with a broad pointed niche cut through it. The prayer cue belongs to the silhouette, joining peace and salah in one emblem.
risk: The rug-wing is intentionally abstract. The niche is clearest at launcher size, while the small icon still reads first as a dove.
key2: A prayer rug as a wing
